intent: Clear the seven over-cap code_tutor test modules by partitioning them at their existing section banners, taking the package from thirteen violations to zero.
scope: Non-goal: no assertion changed, no test deleted, skipped or weakened
changes: Wrote a small splitter that cuts a module at a named section banner and copies the ENTIRE original header into the new file, then let ruff's F401 pass prune what each half does not use. That ordering is deliberate: hand-guessing the import block caused an intermediate failure in every earlier test split in this session, and here it pruned 59 imports correctly with none missed.
Ten new modules, each named after the concern it covers rather than a partN suffix.

_make_verifier was defined between two banners in test_verifier.py, so the cut left it behind while its callers moved. Rather than duplicate it, it moved to tests/conftest.py where _make_live_mock already lives - and test_verifier.py's local _make_live_mock, which had been shadowing conftest's identical copy, was deleted with it.
No patch string changed anywhere in this commit. The source splits in the preceding commits had already put every patched name in the module each test file names, so this is a pure partition.

verification.command: timeout 120 env PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest python_pkg/code_tutor/tests -q
verification.evidence: 217 passed - identical to the count before the split. The single intermediate failure (4 failed, 213 passed) still summed to 217, which confirmed at a glance that the split had misplaced a helper rather than lost a test.
No output - python_pkg/code_tutor is entirely under the 250-line cap, down from thirteen violations at the start of the package.

verification.command: pre-commit run --files <the touched test files and artifacts>
verification.evidence: ruff pruned 59 then 15 unused imports across the new modules; clean on re-run. name-tests-test, mypy, pylint and pytest-with-coverage all pass at 100%.

risks: Copying the whole header and letting ruff prune is safe for imports but not for module-level helpers: ruff has no way to know a function defined mid-file is still needed elsewhere. _make_verifier is the case that proves it, and any future banner split should check for defs sitting between sections before running the suite.
conftest.py now imports Verifier, so a future move of that class must update the fixture builder as well as the test modules.
rollback: git revert the commit; the seven originals return at their previous sizes and the ten new modules disappear.
After rollback, re-run the package suite and confirm it still reports 217 passed.
